name: Gloria Mercado-Fortine
office: City of Santa Clarita, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Gloria Mercado-Fortine is a former member of the William S. Hart Union High School District governing board, where she served 16 years. She chairs the Samuel Dixon Family Health Center board and is a past president of the SCV Sheriff's Foundation. Under her guidance, the health center became a Federally Qualified Health Center and expanded its dental and mental health services.

items.text: Her campaign website says she will prioritize safe neighborhoods and strong schools, along with a thriving local economy. She supports incentives and access to resources for businesses affected by fire.
